planRows.censusName: Hilton Vacation Club Royal Palm St. Maarten
planRows.directoryName: Hilton Vacation Club Royal Palm St. Maarten
planRows.shortDesc: Our oceanfront oasis sets along Welfare Rd on the majestic shores of Simpson Bay. A unique, dual-nation island, you’ll experience diverse cultures and vibes along with stunning white-sand beaches, crystal clear waters, duty-free shopping, and vibrant nightlife. Enjoy spacious accommodations with fully equipped kitchens and amenities such as a pool, onsite dining, and a variety of sports courts.
planRows.headline: Caribbean oasis in St. Maarten
planRows.locationShortDesc: Hilton Royal Palm in St. Maarten is the perfect Caribbean vacation spot with stunning white-sand beaches, crystal clear waters, and diverse cultures.
planRows.directionsTo: Head south on Airport Rd and at the roundabout, take the 1st exit.  Continue onto to Welfare Rd. The resort will be the right just after the Simpson Bay Bridge.
